thread:
maya: Heads up — PR #4523 for the Dedicated provisioning quickstart has a few gaps in the SDK/YAML examples. Not blocking but want a short sweep before Monday.

alex_k: Can you drop the link and a short list of the gaps?

maya: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4523 — main issues: the sample YAML still uses `reservedPool` (camelCase) but our API expects `reserved_pool`; autoscale example references `.autoscale.cooldown` which is deprecated; python SDK snippet calls `provision_capacity` (old name) — should be `create_capacity`.

jonathan: I can take the YAML field rename and add a tiny migration note for folks who automated provisioning. Do we want to mention the CLI flags too?

maya: Yes, please. Add a "Migration note" callout under Quickstart pointing to the CLI and SDK changes. @docs-bot we have a snippet generator — can you regenerate python + ts samples for the new API surface?

docs-bot: snippet-gen: regenerated examples for resource `dedicated_capacity` at commit abc123. Python, TypeScript and YAML examples available here: https://internal/snippets/4523 (internal).

alex_k: I'll do the prose pass and add an autoscale behavior example showing cooldown vs burst. Quick example to copy into the doc:

```yaml
reserved_pool: my-tenant-pool
autoscale:
  policy: cpu
  threshold: 0.65
  cooldown_seconds: 300
  burst_allowed: true
```

This shows the new snake_case fields and `cooldown_seconds` nomenclature. Also think we should add a tiny table: what happens during a cooldown window (no new scale-ups).

sara: Quick Q: SLA wording needs a small tweak. The page currently implies 99.9% for "tenant pools" as a guarantee — legal asked for the per-shard caveat. Can we add a footnote clarifying the SLA is measured per-reserved-pool-shard (see SLA matrix)?

nate: Agree on the SLA footnote. Also we should clarify eviction/isolation semantics: reserved pools are non-preemptible by default — add an example label `preemptible: true` and explain the tradeoffs (lower cost, possible eviction).

maya: Plan: jonathan -> migration note + YAML fix; alex_k -> prose + autoscale snippet + cooldown table; sara -> SLA footnote text and link to SLA matrix; nate -> eviction example + recommended labels. I'll assemble the changes and open a small aggregated PR, tag eng-oncall and docs reviewers. Target EOD Friday. :thumbsup:

alex_k: :thumbsup: starting the prose pass now.

jonathan: Draft branch pushed: `docs/dedicated-qstart-fix` — PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pulls/4578. Added migration note and updated the YAML samples.

maya: Quick nit on the migration note: prefer "tenant unit" to just "tenant" in that sentence for clarity. If everyone else agrees I'll squash and merge after approvals. Thanks all! :pray:
